tokens.name: chart
tokens.usage: Page ground: chart paper by day, deep water by night.

tokens.name: chart-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and the device settings sheet.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only. Under 3:1, so never the only border on a control: control borders use ink-muted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the mark's slats, on chart and chart-raised (12:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata and control borders, on chart and chart-raised (5.4:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Inverse surfaces: the site header band, hero panels, the primary button fill.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a deep fill (13:1 by day, 7:1 by night).

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: The identity accent: the mark's arc and dot, highlights, the drift state. A fill and mark colour, not body text (3.3:1 on chart).

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brass fill, both themes (4.8:1 by day).

tokens.name: brass-text
tokens.usage: Brass as text, on chart, chart-raised and brass-soft (5.1:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: brass-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind brass-text: drift notices, highlighted rows.

tokens.name: sea
tokens.usage: The fix state (position confirmed at an endstop), links and the focus ring; as text on chart and chart-raised (6.3:1 or better).

tokens.name: course
tokens.usage: The navigator's course line: faults, Stop, and destructive actions; as text on chart and chart-raised (5.2:1 or better). Always paired with a word or symbol.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Young Serif, one weight. Titles and the wordmark only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page and section titles on the site and docs. Never in device UI.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans for everything people read.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Headings in docs, settings and the device page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Run the blind fully down and press Stop the moment it lands.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and metadata; set in capitals.

groups.name: Readings
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono for every number a person compares: positions, timings, drift.

styles.name: reading
styles.usage: The big instrument readout: current position and travel time.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Entity IDs, YAML and firmware values.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; slat height in the cover pattern.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; slat pitch.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between page sections; page margin on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Slats, badges, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The position dot and round toggles only.

shadow.note: Flat by default; charts are paper.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Floating menus and popovers only.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px ground-coloured gap, then 2px of solid sea (6:1 or better on chart and chart-raised in both themes).
